request: Customers should be able to browse our plants, open a plant's details, add it to a cart and check out.
reason: A journey across several screens — browse, detail, cart, checkout — so it needs a Flow, Mockups for each screen, and Mock Data to populate them.

request: Add a returns-and-refund process a customer can start from a past order.
reason: A multi-step journey (pick order, choose items, reason, confirm) over real records.

request: Add a stock badge (in stock / low / out) to each plant card.
reason: A single UI component, not a journey. Needs a Mockup and Mock Data to show the states; no Flow.

request: Redesign the plant detail page layout.
reason: One screen redesign — Mockup + Mock Data, no new journey.

request: Add an admin settings screen to edit the flat shipping fee.
reason: Single settings screen; needs a Mockup and a small dataset for the setting value.

request: Show a sales dashboard with a revenue-by-week chart.
reason: A single data-driven screen. One Mockup + Mock Data (orders); not a multi-step journey.

request: Send an order-confirmation email after checkout.
reason: Edge case: an email template IS a user-facing surface, so it needs a Mockup and Mock Data — even though there is no in-app screen.

request: Nightly job that recomputes each plant's low-stock threshold from sales velocity.
reason: Backend logic over real records, no screen. Needs Mock Data so tests have realistic fixtures.

request: Add a REST endpoint GET /plants that returns the catalog as JSON.
reason: An API returns data but has no UI. Mock Data only, for response fixtures.

request: Nightly CSV export of all orders to the finance bucket.
reason: Produces a file from real records, no screen. Mock Data only.

request: Add a database index on orders.created_at to speed up reporting.
reason: Edge case: a schema/perf change with no product surface and no new data semantics. No mocks.

request: Bump the ruff version pinned in the CI config.
reason: Config change, no UI and no business data. No mocks.

request: Write a how-to guide for onboarding a new adopter project.
Rename the skills_config key test_command to test_command_unit.
reason: Config rename with call-site updates; no UI, no product data. No mocks.

request: Let a customer save a plant to a wishlist and view the wishlist later.
reason: A small journey (save from detail, then view the list screen) over real records.

request: Add a static 'About our nursery' page with a hero image and copy.
reason: A single static screen with no business records — a Mockup, but no data to populate and no journey.

request: Add an optional gift-wrap step to the existing checkout flow.
reason: Extends an existing journey with a new step + screen; reuses the existing dataset. EXTEND, do not create a new flow.

request: Add a 'care level' (easy/medium/hard) field to plants.
reason: A new field on an existing entity; extend the canonical Plant dataset rather than create a second one.
